title: Chat question option
description: One answer in a chat question carousel's list (`.chat-question-list-item`): number, label (with optional description), and either a selection check (single-select) or a checkbox (multi-select). Mirrors the list items rendered by ChatQuestionCarouselPart.renderSingleSelect / renderMultiSelect.
usage: Only as a child of <vsc-chat-question-carousel>. Use label (and optionally description, rendered as the product's "Title - Description" two-line row). Mark the default answer with selected. Don't set index or multi yourself; the carousel does.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Option text (the product's option label, or the part before " - ")

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Second line (the part after " - " in the product's option label)

attributes.name: index
attributes.description: 1-based number shown before the label (set by the carousel)

attributes.name: multi
attributes.description: Render as a multi-select checkbox row (set by the carousel)

states.name: selected
states.description: Single-select: row highlighted with a check indicator. Multi-select: checkbox checked.
states.trigger: selected attribute, or click / number key in the carousel

examples.title: Single select (selected, with description)
examples.html: <vsc-chat-question-carousel question="Which language do you want to use?"><vsc-chat-question-option label="TypeScript" description="Strongly typed JavaScript" selected></vsc-chat-question-option><vsc-chat-question-option label="JavaScript" description="Dynamic scripting language"></vsc-chat-question-option><vsc-chat-question-option label="Python" description="General purpose language"></vsc-chat-question-option><vsc-chat-question-option label="Rust" description="Systems programming"></vsc-chat-question-option></vsc-chat-question-carousel>

examples.title: Multi select (checked)
examples.html: <vsc-chat-question-carousel question="Which features should be enabled?" multi><vsc-chat-question-option label="Linting" selected></vsc-chat-question-option><vsc-chat-question-option label="Formatting" selected></vsc-chat-question-option><vsc-chat-question-option label="Testing"></vsc-chat-question-option><vsc-chat-question-option label="CI/CD Pipeline"></vsc-chat-question-option></vsc-chat-question-carousel>
